visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a black t-shirt stands in an elevator with a group of people behind him, some wearing masks. He holds up a white bottle with wide, exaggerated eyes and open mouth. Bright yellow rays emanate from the bottle. (2) The scene shifts to an office setting where a young woman with long dark hair is eating a bowl of noodles. The man in the black shirt pops into the frame holding the same white bottle, pointing at it enthusiastically. (3) The setting changes to a room with a grey wall and a round black table. A different young man is smoking a cigarette. The main creator enters from the right, wearing a black shirt and holding a small toy, then proceeds to spray the white bottle's contents into the smoker's mouth. (4) The creator is now sitting on a grey sofa in a minimalist living room, wearing a black t-shirt and ripped jeans. He holds two white bottles, gesturing with his hands while talking to the camera. (5) A series of fast cuts show different people: a woman sleeping with her mouth open, a woman eating a large burger, a hand holding a cigar and glass of whiskey, and another woman waking up looking distressed. (6) A CGI graphic of a set of teeth appears on screen with the creator's face superimposed onto a tooth, followed by a close-up of two product bottles on a grey background. (7) A young man in front of a mirror uses the product, followed by a girl with a ponytail doing the same. The video ends with the main creator on the sofa giving a thumbs up while holding the products.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian male with short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and blue ripped jeans. He is highly expressive with animated facial gestures.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves through an elevator interior, a modern office with workstations, a minimalist living room with a grey sofa and picture frames, and a simple bathroom with a mirror.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with an enthusiastic greeting. Upbeat, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse enters. A bright 'ding' sound effect coincides with the product reveal. (2) Vocal delivery speeds up slightly while maintaining a persuasive tone. An audible slurping sound effect is used as noodles are shown, followed by a 'whoosh' transition effect. (3) BGM continues steadily. A distinct, airy 'pssh' spray sound effect is repeated twice during the mouth-spray demonstration. (4) Narration tone shifts to a questioning, slightly comedic style to describe problems. A 'boing' cartoon sound effect highlights the text on screen. (5) Quick cuts in narration match rapid visual changes. Brief, punchy sound triggers occur with each scenario change. (6) Narration becomes more informative, explaining ingredients. Digital 'bubble' and 'pop' sound effects play during the CGI demonstration of cleaning teeth. (7) Final summary in a high-arousal, positive tone. BGM swells slightly toward the end. A final 'ding' chime sounds as the thumbs-up gesture is shown, followed by a quick fade to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Scenarios -> Solution -> Product Features -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the TRUE TISANE Tooth Mousse by humorously identifying the struggle of 'people with bad breath' (口臭人) and presenting the product as an instant, effective solution for various daily situations like after eating smelly food or smoking.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, naming the brand 'TRUE TISANE', and listing specific benefits and usage instructions.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-energy social media editing styles, including fast cuts, meme-like text overlays, and expressive acting to keep viewers engaged while delivering a clear marketing message for a personal hygiene product.
